name: Banh tom
summary: Banh tom is a West Lake shrimp cake: shredded sweet potato, fried, with a whole shrimp set in the top.
origin: Hanoi. The cakes are called bánh tôm Hồ Tây because they were first made with freshwater shrimp from West Lake.
texture: The fried cake is crisp. The shrimp shell softens in the oil and stays crunchy enough to eat with the crust.
howToEat: Wrap the fritter in lettuce, dip it in fish sauce, and drink it with a cold beer.
The shrimp in the cake now comes from other waterways.
where: West Lake, the lake the cakes are named for.
seoTitle: Banh tom — West Lake shrimp cakes
seoDescription: Banh tom Ho Tay is a fried sweet-potato shrimp cake from Hanoi. Wrap it in lettuce and dip it in fish sauce.
